proposed_fixes.title: Match workspace applications by stable PWA identity
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Workspaces can identify a browser PWA only when PwaHelper resolves a non-empty PWA application ID from the window AUMID. The existing-window matcher permits a name-or-path match when both saved and observed pwaAppId values are empty, and the newly launched-window matcher compares only name/path. Those fallback paths can let an ordinary Chrome window satisfy a saved Chrome PWA slot.
plan: Prefer AppUserModelId or shortcut identity and reject generic Chrome for PWA slots.

affected_files.purpose: Matches existing and newly launched windows to saved workspace applications.
Resolves Chrome and Edge PWA IDs and names from window/package identity.
Declares the PWA identity resolver used by the arranger.
Provides native coverage for PWA identity extraction.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: GetNearestWindow accepts name-or-path equality plus pwaAppId equality, including the ambiguous empty/empty case; processWindow matches newly observed windows by name or path without checking PWA identity.
implementation_steps.change: When the saved workspace entry represents a PWA, require a successfully resolved, exact PWA application ID before an existing or newly observed browser window can satisfy it. Never treat an ordinary Chrome/Edge window with an empty PWA ID as that PWA.
edge_cases: Do not reject ordinary saved Chrome/Edge browser windows.
Keep multiple PWAs from the same browser distinct.
Do not move a fallback browser window when PWA identity extraction fails.
tests: Saved Gmail PWA does not match normal Chrome.
Saved Gmail and Calendar PWAs match their own windows.
Ordinary saved Chrome continues to match ordinary Chrome.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: PWA identity extraction may return no ID, after which callers can fall back to generic browser identity.
implementation_steps.change: Return explicit unresolved identity and diagnostic context for PWA candidates so the arranger can refuse an ambiguous generic-browser fallback while still launching the missing PWA.
edge_cases: PWA updates that retain app ID but change title.
tests: Known Chrome and Edge AUMIDs resolve stable IDs.
Unknown AUMID remains unresolved instead of becoming generic browser identity.
